quotes.name: Melton Neilon
quotes.quote: Honestly, Dimond is still a bit of a mystery to me, I mean, I've heard it's a great neighborhood with a lot of heart, but I don't really know much about it beyond that. As a baker in Temescal, I tend to focus on my own community, but I'm always interested in what's going on in other parts of the city. I think community programs can really make a difference in people's lives, and I'd love to learn more about what's happening in Dimond.
